description: This Python script demonstrates using the Perplexity API for chat completion as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI's interface, specifically in a voice interaction pipeline involving speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and real-time communication abstractions. It sets up a conversational pipeline with various services and handles client connections, disconnections, and streaming of data.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the conversational context with initial messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of context and user parameters, facilitating interaction with the LLM in the pipeline.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy for stopping user turns based on analysis.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Collection of strategies to manage user turn-taking.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the data flow.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with its configuration and state.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline run.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including starting, stopping, and signal handling.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the conversational pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, setting up transport and initiating the run.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to start the Python script, calling the main runner function.
